source_name: Wikidata Entity Data API — structured facts for airport public profiles

license.name: CC0 1.0
license.attribution: Wikidata structured data is released under CC0 1.0. The airport_public_profiles table stores a WikidataAttribution (qid, url) per row.

what_it_provides: Structured facts (opened/inception, operator, owner, official website, main image, ICAO/IATA, coordinate location) for the Wikidata entity linked to an airport article. The airport_public_profile normalizer extracts interesting facts from a fixed property map (P571 / P137 / P127 / P856 / P18 / P239 / P238 / P625) and stores them with property_id and source='wikidata'.

refresh_policy.schedule_note: Wikidata is fetched on demand when an airport public profile is built or refreshed. Throttled to 1 request every 2 seconds (WIKIDATA_THROTTLE_SECONDS=2.0) when used by the airport_intelligence_ingest_worker. Cached for 30 days.

freshness_policy.notes: Same 30-day TTL as the Wikipedia side; both feed the same airport_public_profiles row and the same airport_public_profile_versions chain.

raw_storage.bucket: n/a (no raw blob persisted; response is parsed inline and stored as normalized fields in airport_public_profiles / airport_public_profile_versions)
raw_storage.path_pattern: not applicable — see airport_public_profiles + airport_public_profile_versions tables instead

collector.name: wikimedia_wikidata_fetcher.fetch_wikidata_entity (and fetch_airport_public_data)
collector.user_agent: god-eyes/1.0 (https://github.com/anomalyco/god-eyes; god-eyes@example.com) WikipediaEnrichmentFetcher/1.0 — required by Wikimedia policy; do NOT anonymize

frontend_usage.barrel: apps/web/src/layers/layer_01_aviation/index.ts re-exports useAirportPublicProfile and the profile types

known_limitations: User-Agent is mandatory per Wikimedia policy; the documented UA in airport_public_profile.py is a placeholder email that may be replaced by a real ops contact before production.
QID resolution from ICAO/IATA is best-effort; low-confidence matches are recorded in profile.match with match_confidence != 'high'.
The interesting_facts list is limited to the WIKIDATA_PROPERTY_MAP in airport_public_profile.py; additional properties are not currently surfaced to the frontend.
When the airport_intelligence_ingest_worker falls back to ICAO-based QID resolution, a failed lookup is recorded with match_method='wikidata_icao_lookup_failed' and match_confidence='medium'.
pipeline_source_id_note: The fetcher and normalizer write rows with the bundled pipeline source_id 'airport_public_enrichment' (defined in packages/schemas/layers/layer_01_aviation/airport_public_profile.py as SOURCE_ID). The airport_source_links table also records source_type='wikidata' for cross-references; this catalog entry is keyed on the upstream provider.
notes: This catalog source_id ('wikidata_airport_profiles') identifies the upstream provider only; it is not the value persisted in the DB. The pipeline-level source_id is 'airport_public_enrichment' (see pipeline_source_id_note).

Wikidata is also used by the airport_intelligence_ingest_worker (WO-043) to fill airport intelligence modules (inception, operator, owner, official website, image, ICAO/IATA). The WIKIDATA_THROTTLE_SECONDS=2.0 throttle in that worker is a separate concern from the public-profile path.
